**Introduction**
----------------

The **[Product Auction App](https://apps.shopify.com/product-auction)** now supports **Shopify Auction Klaviyo Integration**, allowing merchants to manage and send auction-related emails through Klaviyo.

This integration helps merchants create professional email templates in Klaviyo and use them for different auction email notifications.

To use this feature, you need to install and activate the **Mailing with Klaviyo** app from the **Feature Apps** section of the Product Auction App.

**How to Activate Sending Mails with the Klaviyo Feature**
----------------------------------------------------------

To enable the Mailing with Klaviyo feature:

1.  Open the **Product Auction App**.

![first](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyofirst-1200x524.webp)

2.  Go to the **Feature Apps** section.

![two](https://chatwhizz-new.s3.amazonaws.com/chatwhizz_main/webkul/k84g1b83eimqp37c3a/screenshot_1782124985721.jpeg?v=1782127493798)

3.  Find the **Mailing with Klaviyo** app.

![three](https://chatwhizz-new.s3.amazonaws.com/chatwhizz_main/webkul/qd551cimqp37pnt/screenshot_1782125003309.jpeg?v=1782127566017)

4.  Activate the app to start using the Klaviyo integration.

Once activated, you can configure Klaviyo settings from the Product Auction App.

**How to Generate Klaviyo Private API Key**
-------------------------------------------

To connect Klaviyo with the Product Auction App, you need to generate the Klaviyo Private API Key from your Klaviyo account.

Follow these steps to create the API key:

1.  Login to your **Klaviyo account**.

![five](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyosettings-1200x524.webp)

2.  Navigate to **Settings**.
3.  Under the Settings menu, open the **General** section.
4.  Go to the **API Keys** option.

![six](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/createprivatekey-1200x524.webp)

5.  Click on **Create Private Key**.
6.  Enter a name for your API key according to your requirement.
7.  Select the required access permission and provide **Full Access**.

![seven](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/fullaccesskey-1200x524.webp)

8.  Click on **Create Key**.

Once the key is created, Klaviyo will generate a Private API Key.

![eight](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/key-1-1200x524.webp)

Copy the generated key and use it in the **Klaviyo Configs** section of the Product Auction App to complete the integration.

**Configure Klaviyo API Details**
---------------------------------

After activating the feature, navigate to:

**Product Auction App → Configuration → Klaviyo Configs**

Here, you need to enter your Klaviyo API credentials to connect your store with Klaviyo.

![nine](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyofour-1200x524.webp)

You need to add the following details:

*   **Klaviyo Private API Name**
*   **Klaviyo Private API Key**

After adding the required credentials, save the configuration.

The Klaviyo integration will now be connected with the Product Auction App.

**Configure Auction Email Templates with Klaviyo**
--------------------------------------------------

After connecting Klaviyo, go to:

**Product Auction App → Mail Config**

Select the required **mail template**.

![ten](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyofourfive-1200x524.webp)

Each auction email template will have the option to choose the mailing method:

1 - Through Klaviyo

2 - Through Default Smtp

![Sel](data:image/png;base64,)

Choose **Klaviyo** as the mailing method for that template and click on **Map on Klaviyo**.

![eleven](https://chatwhizz-new.s3.amazonaws.com/chatwhizz_main/webkul/k84g1b83eimqqfmfpk/screenshot_1782206311496.jpeg?v=1782206314381)

**Create Klaviyo Flow for Auction Emails**
------------------------------------------

After creating and mapping the template, you need to create a flow in Klaviyo.

Follow these steps:

1.  Login to Klaviyo.

![thirteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyoseven-1200x524.webp)

2.  Go to the **Flows** section.

![fourteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyoeight-1200x524.webp)

3.  Click on **Create Flow**.

![fourteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyonine-1200x524.webp)

4.  Select **Build Your Own** option.

Now, add:

*   Flow Name

![fifteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyoten-1200x524.webp)

*   Required Tags

Use the same email template name/tag that you mapped in the Product Auction App.

After adding details, click on **Create Flow**.

**Configure Flow Trigger**
--------------------------

After creating the flow, you will be redirected to the trigger selection page.

Follow these steps:

1.  Go to the **All Triggers** section.

![sixteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyoeleven-1200x524.webp)

2.  Select **Metric** as the trigger type.

![seventeen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyotwelve-1200x524.webp)

3.  Search for the mapped email template name.
4.  Select the required metric.

The setup trigger page will appear.

![eighteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyothirteen-1200x524.webp)

Click on **Save** to continue.

**Add Email Action in Klaviyo Flow**

After saving the trigger, you will reach the Flow Actions section.

To add the email action:

1.  Click on the **\+ (Plus)** icon below the End button.

![nineteen](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyofourteen-1200x524.webp)

2.  Select **Email**.
3.  Open Email Details.
4.  Select **Choose Template**.

![twenty](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyofifteen-1200x524.webp)

You will be redirected to the Templates page.

Now:

1.  Search for your created email template.

![twentyone](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyosixteen-1200x524.webp)

2.  Select the template.
3.  Click on **Use Template**.

![twentytwo](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyoseventeen-1200x524.webp)

**Configure Email Details**

After selecting the template, configure the email details:

*   Template Name
*   Subject Line

![twentythree](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyoeighteen-1200x524.webp)

Once completed, click on **Done**.

Your Klaviyo flow email setup is now completed.

**Manage Flow Status**

After completing the configuration, you can choose how you want to run the email flow:

*   **Draft** – Keep the flow saved but inactive.
*   **Manual** – Review and manage the flow manually.
*   **Live** – Activate the flow and start sending auction emails automatically.

![twntyfour](https://cdnblog.webkul.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/klaviyonineteen-1200x524.webp)

**Conclusion**

The Mailing with Klaviyo integration for the [Product Auction App](https://webkul.com/blog/shopify-product-auction/) provides merchants with a powerful way to manage auction email notifications using Klaviyo’s email automation system.

With this integration, merchants can create customized email templates, map them with auction events, and automate communication with bidders and customers.
